effectiveDamage: function effectiveDamage() { return PROJECTILE_DAMAGE * (1 + effectLevel("big-water") * UPGRADE_TUNING.damagePerLevel); }
effectiveShotInterval: function effectiveShotInterval() { return Math.max(0.12, (activeWeapon().kind === "melee" ? activeWeapon().interval : SHOT_INTERVAL) * (1 - effectLevel("rapid-water") * UPGRADE_TUNING.fireRateReduction) / cardBlock('wind-speed','onShot',{moving:state.moveRate||0}).actions[0].multiplier); }
